text: tlapm's pin moves from commit 4744c0f to eef4b65, refining D-0229 (#385). Upstream replaced the rolling 1.6.0-pre release's assets on 2026-11-01 with a build two commits on: b8ddf62 adds SANY as an optional parser backend, with new --parser and --module-jar flags, and eef4b65 merges it (tlaplus/tlapm#275). The pinned tarball was gone, so, as D-0229 intends, the TLAPS image failed to build instead of installing another tlapm, and the gate failed on every change. The gate now pins the new x86_64 Linux tarball, sha256:b0038e59a6bddc9aa9a75e7c3320e20333f02fd7ba745ea64f1cc1c9800e43e8, 53,103,056 bytes. It adds one file, tla2tools.jar from tlaplus's v1.8.0 release of 2026-10-30, which tlapm runs only for --parser SANY; the gate never passes --parser, so tlapm still parses with its own parser, the default, under --strict, --prefer-stdlib and --nofp. Nothing else the gate relies on changed: Z3 4.8.9, Zenon 0.8.4, LS4 and the standard library are byte for byte the same, Isabelle is still Isabelle2025, its TLA+ and Options heaps rebuilt from unchanged theories, --config differs only in the commit, test/soundness_tests is unchanged, so the known-soundness list stands, and tlapm still names a primed hidden definition's atom as tlapsAtom does, so it still proves the false lemma about a colliding pair by SMT that D-0243 refuses. The real TLAPS suite passed 8 of 8, and examples/05-connection-pool passes with the same 8 obligations (1 ls4, 3 smt, 4 trivial). The release is still rolling, so it will be replaced again; a durable source for the tarball is a separate call for @gitdek.
